verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes DeepInfra as a pay-per-token inference API with zero data retention, private dedicated deployments, and GPU clusters, but there is no mention of a distinct sandbox/test environment, test API keys, or any mechanism to separate test traffic from production data — instead it just uses live API keys against production endpoints. missing for 10: sandbox/test environment or mode, staging API keys, documented separation between test and production data flows.
